साउथ सिनेमा के दो दिग्गज सुपरस्टार्स का यह मज़ाकिया अंदाज़ सोशल मीडिया पर खूब तहलका मचा रहा है! 🎬✨

फिल्म O M Chapter 1 के pre-release event के दौरान दिग्गज एक्टर ममूटी ने अपने co-star धनुष की जमकर टांग खिंचाई की। इवेंट के दौरान ममूटी ने मज़ाकिया अंदाज़ में बयान दिया कि धनुष मेरे देखे बिना सो ही नहीं पाते हैं! 😲😂

ममूटी के इस चटपटे बयान ने इवेंट में मौजूद सभी लोगों को हंसा-हंसाकर लोटपोट कर दिया। दोनों एक्टर्स के बीच की यह खट्टी-मीठी बॉन्डिंग फैंस को बेहद पसंद आ रही है और फिल्म O M Chapter 1 को लेकर दर्शकों का एक्साइटमेंट और बढ़ गया है। 🔥

क्या आप ममूटी और धनुष की इस जोड़ी को O M Chapter 1 में देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में ज़रूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: O M Chapter 1: Mammootty pulls co star Dhanush’s leg at pre-release event; says ‘He cannot sleep without seeing me’
ctx.summary:
O.M Chapter 1, starring Dhanush and Mammootty in the lead roles, is slated for a theatrical release on November 20, 2026. Ahead of Rajkumar Periasamy's directorial release, Mammootty playfully pulled his co-star's leg at the film's pre-release event in Kerala. 
 O.M Chapter 1: Mammootty quips at Dhanush for his initial approach to him 
 Speaking at the pre-release event for  O.M Chapter 1 , Mammootty recalled how Dhanush initially kept his distance whenever they met. He said, “Initially, Dhanush used to get tense whenever he saw me. Not even tense; he would keep his distance, actually. But would I leave him? We can even turn enemies into friends, right? I embraced him and made him my friend. Now, he can’t even sleep without seeing me.” 
 When it was his turn to speak, Dhanush responded with a humorous anecdote, saying, “Legendary Nagesh sir once advised me to be careful with someone who doesn’t look like they act. After 24 years, that advice came in handy while acting with Mammootty sir. If I hadn’t been careful, he would’ve finished me off and left.” 
 The actor further joked, “Mammootty sir means thug life; thug life means Mammootty. He will never give you normal answers. I once asked him, ‘How are you doing, sir?’ He replied, ‘How do you think I am?’ When I said he must be good, he replied, ‘In that case, I must be.’”
